items.title: Badenoch says Tories would scrap inheritance tax on family homes
items.summary: Tory leader says her party is "coming back", as she aims to convince voters it has changed after 2024 election defeat.

items.title: Family of GP found dead at home pay tribute to 'kind and loving' mother
items.summary: The family of a GP who was found dead at home in Norfolk has paid tribute to her "kind, generous and loving" nature.

items.title: Family tribute to 'kind and loving' GP found dead at home
items.summary: Hannah Cain's family say they have been "devastated" by her death on Sunday.

items.title: Southampton owner says 'we have suffered enough' as manager gets suspended ban over Spygate scandal
items.summary: The head coach of Southampton FC has been given a suspended ban of six weeks and a fine of £28,000 over his role in the Spygate scandal.

items.title: Man jailed for killing ex days after early release
items.summary: Robert Sabat is given a 17-year-minimum jail term for the fatal stabbing of his former partner.

items.title: £6.7bn deal to buy Boots' 1,800 UK and Ireland stores
items.summary: A deal has been announced which would see the £6.7bn sale of the 1,800 Boots stores across the UK and Ireland.
